acceptance: Both criteria must pass; primal candidate must be feasible and dual bound valid.
on_failure: Record failure; do not silently accept or relax either tolerance.
implementation_status: Integrated certified row-sharded solver and fixed-horizon published-method runner; GPU validation is recorded separately.
theory_status: Numerical accuracy choice, not a theorem-derived inexactness guarantee.
numerical_acceptance: Both actual stored-plan marginal L1 and (max(raw_gap, stable_gap)+roundoff)/max(1,abs(primal),abs(dual)) must be <= their selected tolerances; validate FP64 feasible witness and gap crosscheck.
primal_witness: Separately rounded FP64 witness; record L1 difference from actual stored plan.
failure_policy: Exit nonzero, retain failed certificate and inner work counters; never accept failure or relax tolerances.
